body:
Fixes:
1. Healthy-week ribbon: not playing also earns it (away = paused). Fix: cared for on 3+ days that week, never sick.
2. Pet Show: 4 pets per show. 5th friend? Fix: first 4 join, the rest get the next show right after.
3. Vet: several sick pets? Fix: one visit treats every sick pet following you, pay per pet.
4. Old saves: today's one happiness becomes four needs. Fix: each need starts at the old happiness.
5. Riding: your pets wait at the stable and come back when you get off.
6. Farm: eggs and milk once per game day per player, so they can't be farmed for endless coins.
Tidy-ups:
7. 8 answered pet questions → Paused and old.
8. Pet decision 20 (old stage order) → Paused and old. Plan's 6 stages replace it.
9. 11 of Izabele's ideas (tennis, dance, save slots…) → Ideas chapter.
